Apply B9b.12-diag hotfix — bumps the AntiGhosting validator-rejection log from debug to info so the rejection reason surfaces in prod.

1. Decode + apply:

echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/apply-b9b12-diag.py && python3 /tmp/apply-b9b12-diag.py

   Expect:
   [ok]   bumped logger.debug -> logger.info
   [ok]   wrote artifacts/api-server/src/services/antiGhostingIngest.ts
   B9b.12-diag applied.

2. Typecheck (this file isn't normally exposed to typecheck issues but worth a gate):
   cd artifacts/api-server && pnpm run typecheck && cd -

3. Build + restart:
   cd artifacts/api-server && pnpm run build && cd -

4. Restart api-server workflow.

5. Republish.

6. On https://doctrine-followupv-2.replit.app/anti-ghosting/inspector, click "Sync Now" again.

7. Pull prod logs. Look for "AntiGhosting auto-ingest skipped" — there should now be an INFO line with a `reason` field. Paste it.
